facts.claim: CodeAgent runs LLM-written Python with no approval step; control is the interpreter's import/function allowlist.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D01.rationale: No approval mechanism; autonomous code execution.

facts.claim: Default executor_type='local' = in-process AST interpreter; docs: no local sandbox can be completely secure; recommended isolation = docker/e2b/modal/blaxel executors (opt-in).
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: 5 GHSAs incl. critical sandbox escape CVE-2025-5120 (fixed 1.17.0) and CVE-2026-4963 (incomplete fix, CVE-2025-9959 follow-up) in LocalPythonExecutor.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: No Wasm/Pyodide executor in src/ (lead's mention not supported by source).
facts.label: from-official-docs

D02.rationale: Weak default boundary, real sandboxes opt-in.

facts.claim: No egress control in LocalPythonExecutor; SSRF via requests in authorised code (CVE-2026-2654, no fix listed).
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: DockerExecutor publishes the Jupyter kernel gateway on host 127.0.0.1:8888 by default.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: MCPClient / ToolCollection.from_mcp require trust_remote_code=True for stdio; Hub tools need trust_remote_code=True (default False).
facts.label: from-official-docs

D06.rationale: Opt-in trust gate for Hub code.

facts.claim: smolagent CLI accepts --api-key on the command line (process-list exposure); otherwise env vars; remote executors do not receive secrets.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Only in-run AgentMemory; no persistent store.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: managed_agents share the process; with remote executors multi-agent needs the entire system run inside the sandbox.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D10.rationale: Isolation only by running everything in a sandbox.

facts.claim: OpenTelemetry via OpenInference SmolagentsInstrumentor is opt-in; agent step memory kept in run.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: No telemetry in library; opt-in OTel only.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: SECURITY.md with private reporting and security@huggingface.co, no bounty; GHSAs: CVE-2025-5120 (critical, fixed 1.17.0), CVE-2025-11844 (fixed 1.22.0), CVE-2025-14931 (critical pickle RCE in remote executor), CVE-2026-2654, CVE-2026-4963 (no fixed version listed).
facts.label: from-official-docs

D15.rationale: Active but several advisories list no patched version.
